info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, podsFront, loopX, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  podsFront = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 1)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  this.locZ = 103  podsFront.locZ = 1001endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos    podsFront.loc = this.loc  end ifend
